checked_obligation: Verify that substituting y=2n−1 into t²=12n²−12n+1 yields t²−3y²=−2 and preserves the condition that n is a positive integer as y is positive and odd.
reason: Since n=(y+1)/2, direct expansion gives 12n²−12n+1=3(y+1)²−6(y+1)+1=3y²−2. Thus t²=3y²−2, equivalently t²−3y²=−2. Moreover, n>0 integral implies y=2n−1 is positive and odd, and conversely every positive odd y gives a positive integer n=(y+1)/2. No external theorem is needed.
